Add to schema:
```typescript
export const hashtagMentions = pgTable("hashtag_mentions", {
  id: serial("id").primaryKey(),
  platform: varchar("platform", { length: 50 }).notNull(), // 'tiktok', 'instagram', 'youtube', 'twitter', 'facebook'
  postUrl: text("post_url").notNull().unique(),
  postId: varchar("post_id", { length: 255 }), // Platform-specific ID

  discoveredAt: timestamp("discovered_at").defaultNow().notNull(),
  processedAt: timestamp("processed_at"), // When matched to user
  matchedUserId: varchar("matched_user_id", { length: 36 }).references(() => users.id),
  source: varchar("source", { length: 50 }).notNull(), // 'apify', 'brand24', etc.
  metadata: jsonb("metadata"), // Raw provider data
});
```

## Migration: drizzle/0008_hashtag_mentions.sql

```sql
CREATE TABLE hashtag_mentions (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  platform VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  post_url TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  post_id VARCHAR(255),
  author_handle VARCHAR(255),
  author_name VARCHAR(255),
  content TEXT,
  engagement JSONB,
  posted_at TIMESTAMP,
  discovered_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL,
  processed_at TIMESTAMP,
  matched_user_id VARCHAR(36) REFERENCES users(id),
  source VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  metadata JSONB
);

CREATE INDEX idx_hashtag_mentions_platform ON hashtag_mentions(platform);
CREATE INDEX idx_hashtag_mentions_posted_at ON hashtag_mentions(posted_at);
CREATE INDEX idx_hashtag_mentions_author_handle ON hashtag_mentions(author_handle);
CREATE INDEX idx_hashtag_mentions_matched_user ON hashtag_mentions(matched_user_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_hashtag_mentions_source ON hashtag_mentions(source);
```

## Apply Migration
```bash
source .env.local && psql "$DATABASE_URL" -f drizzle/0008_hashtag_mentions.sql
```

title: Implement ZIP packaging service
description:
Create service to package all export components into a downloadable ZIP file.

- Create ZIP with proper directory structure
- Stream ZIP creation for memory efficiency
- Support large media files without loading all into memory
- Set proper file permissions in ZIP

- Create `lib/export/packager.ts`

- Function: `createExportPackage(data: ExportPackage): ReadableStream`

## Package Structure
```
portfolio-export.zip
├── index.html              # Main site
├── manifest.json           # Portfolio metadata
├── README.md              # Deployment instructions
├── assets/
│   ├── styles.css         # If separated
│   └── fonts/

└── media/
    ├── images/
```

```typescript
const archive = archiver('zip', { zlib: { level: 6 } })
archive.append(htmlContent, { name: 'index.html' })
archive.directory('media/', 'media')
return archive
```

title: Create milestone checking service
description:
Build the core engine that checks and awards milestones.

## Service: lib/milestones/index.ts

### checkAndAwardMilestones(userId: string)
Called by hashtag monitoring handler when a post is detected.

1. Get user's current monthly post count (from posts table)
2. Get user's lifetime_post_count
3. Get all milestones from milestones table
4. For each milestone:
   - Check if threshold is met
   - Check if already earned (in user_milestones)
   - If eligible and not earned, insert into user_milestones
5. For monthly milestones, check with current month_year

### revokeExpiredMilestones(userId: string)
Called if a post is removed or invalidated.

1. Get current counts
2. Check earned milestones against current counts
3. Delete user_milestones entries that no longer qualify
4. For monthly milestones, only check current month

## Integration
Called from lib/hashtag-monitoring/handler.ts (provider-agnostic)

## Files
- lib/milestones/index.ts
- lib/milestones/queries.ts

title: Integrate background job processing for generation
description:

## Purpose
Portfolio generation can take 1-5 minutes - too long for serverless functions. Need background processing.

- Easy Next.js integration
- Built-in retries and logging
- Good free tier
- Can run locally for development

```typescript
// lib/inngest/client.ts
import { Inngest } from 'inngest'
export const inngest = new Inngest({ id: 'ugc-community' })

// lib/inngest/functions.ts
export const generatePortfolio = inngest.createFunction(
  { id: 'generate-portfolio' },
  { event: 'portfolio/generate.requested' },
  async ({ event, step }) => {
    const { questionnaireId } = event.data
    // ... generation logic
  }
)
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Generation runs asynchronously
- [ ] Progress can be tracked
- [ ] Failures are retried
- [ ] Logs are accessible

title: Add generation status tracking to database
description:
Add database fields to track portfolio generation status and history.

## Purpose
Track generation attempts, status, and results for each questionnaire/user.

## Schema Changes
Add to users table or create new table:

```sql
-- Option A: Add to users table
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN portfolio_generation_status text;
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN portfolio_generation_started_at timestamp;
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN portfolio_generation_completed_at timestamp;
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN portfolio_generation_error text;

-- Option B: New table for generation history
CREATE TABLE portfolio_generations (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  questionnaire_id uuid REFERENCES onboarding_questionnaires(id),
  status text NOT NULL, -- 'pending', 'generating', 'pushing', 'deploying', 'completed', 'failed'
  github_repo text,
  deployment_url text,
  error text,
  started_at timestamp DEFAULT now(),
  completed_at timestamp
);
```

## Recommended: Option B
- Keeps history of all generation attempts
- Can track multiple generations per user
- Cleaner separation of concerns

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Migration created and applied
- [ ] Schema updated in schema.ts
- [ ] Can track generation status
- [ ] Can view generation history
- [ ] Errors are stored for debugging
